reviews.text: Staff & Doctor were very attentive and caring. My Olive feels very comfortable and safe.
Very kind staff.  They were focused on my pet's comfort during the entire visit.
Excellent feline healthcare. The Dr was very patient, caring and thorough with both of our Maine Coons. Happy so far!
Very professional and caring. Great communication throughout the process and follow up after care.  Easy of online appointment scheduling.

Feline Medical Center has been taking care of all 4 of my cats since I moved to Texas 5 years ago. They mainly see Dr. Sims but have seen Dr. Moran and Dr. Smith before as well during urgent situations. All the doctors are wonderful with my cats and they really do care about keeping them stress free and comfortable. I have a very medically complex cat who sees Dr. Sims routinely and she is always up to date on his latest issues and listens to all my wild research theories. I recently lost one of my 4 to cancer and they sent me the most beautiful cat friendly flowers the very next day. 10/10 would recommend taking your cats here.

My family and I have been using Feline Medical since before they branched off to their own practice (approximately the past 20 years). We couldn't be more pleased with their staff, professionalism, and passion for what they do.

Now that I'm married and have cats of my own, I am pleased to continue working with all the wonderful vet techs and vets at Feline Medical.

Truly the best feline-based vet around - you won't get better service anywhere else.
Kind caring and informative group.
We greatly appreciate your positive feedback! Thank you for sharing your experience with us.
Thankful for them to help find what was wrong with my sweet kitty!

Feline Medical Center is cat specific, and everyone there loves their job! My cat is always taken care of extremely well and I leave knowing he got the best care. I have seen multiple doctors there and they are all wonderful!
Great care and service.
Had a great experience  with our check ups . Minimized the cats stress  and thorough examination . Always a caring team
Excellent first visit with a caring and compassionate, professional staff from the front desk to the technician specialists
highly impressed , words cannot be put together to express how amazing this place is. Very thankful they were recommended to me. My baby has been nothing but welcomed, and well taken care of.

This was our second visit to Feline Medical Center, and once again they were wonderful! My Bengal, Carole Baskin had to be seen for an upper respiratory infection.

Carole is actually a pretty laid-back cat and didn’t mind the visit at all, which says a lot about how calm and welcoming the clinic is. The staff was so kind and gentle with her, and the doctor was incredibly friendly, thorough, and took the time to answer all of my questions without making us feel rushed.

It’s clear everyone here truly loves cats, and that makes all the difference. We’re so grateful for the excellent care Carole received and will definitely be back. Highly recommend Feline Medical Center to any cat parent!
They always take such great care of my cat Daphne. The staff is super flexible and happy to answer any questions I may have.
Professional

Absolutely a very professional experience. Even though my cat, Combat, was very sick and I was extremely upset we both were treated with kindness and compassion! Less than 24 hours later Combat is recovering! Thank you so much for saving Combat’s life!

I’m new to town and have been to multiple places with an acute situation with my baby Bella. The Feline Medical Center far and above, gave me confidence over the others. Everybody’s so easy to talk to and work with to craft a plan, especially for us.  They are so caring with Bella and even with me; empathetic about what we had been through. A big thank you to them and a high recommendation!

Everyone is extremely friendly, and they walk you through everything.
Very lucky to have this team so close to where I live. I won't take my cats anywhere else

Great experience. I took my senior cat here and with just a couple recommended adjustments, she is doing better than she has in a couple years going to a dog/cat vet. I like that the office focuses on just cats rather than being a jack of all trades. Highly recommend vet for you cat moms and dads!

I'm super excited to have found this place! After calling 15 vets to get my 4wk old rescue kitten in because I was worried about him, this vet was able to see me the same day. Dr. Moran and her assistant, Patricia, were patient and put me and Phineas at ease. I didn't feel rushed, the wait wasn't long, and they are reasonably priced. The fact that they only care for cats is a huge plus, especially because I have an older cat with arthritis. They also went above and beyond and communicated with me via text when I was out of town. If I could give 10 stars I would! I'm so glad that my babies have a loving, caring, and communicative team taking care of them!
Just like when Kero was alive, they did very well with Princess Ninja. It’s very appreciated because it was her first vet visit and I really appreciate how kind and careful they were.
Thank you for your generous review! We appreciate your feedback and hope to see you again soon!
Thank you for the great feedback! We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience at The Feline Medical Center and appreciate you allowing us to care for your pet.

Dear cat owner

Please do not blindly trust these people

My cat was sick and they “missed” so many signs

If I would have done my own research instead of trusting them 100% … my baby would still be here today

Feels like they withheld info from me for some reason

Now I’ll never be able to hold my baby ever again

I don’t wish this feeling on anyone

Please take care of your baby
We are so luckily we are so close to this vet. They are miracle workers. They truly love cats so much and take care of all of our babies. Couldn’t recommend enough

beware of this place
they will misdiagnose your cat
they do not value your cats life the same way you do
Very Professional and caring Veterinarian Service
We're grateful for your 5-star rating! Thank you for choosing The Feline Medical Center.

Was able to get me and my cat in the day after the referral was sent over from our regular vet. They were very kind and have called several times after her appointment to check on her and see how she is doing. The only “issue” I had was pricing. It is very expensive, although they are specialists so that is to be expected.

Like the other one stars, I was suggested an X-ray but issue was found and the X-ray wasn’t needed. Instead of calling and conveying that   before proceeding they decided to x-ray “just in case” I believe was said. I take issue with that. If you wouldn’t have then one star wouldn’t apply to you. I for one while running a business would not leverage my expertise to make someone pay more than needed, excessively more. The bulk of the bill spent today was based off something not needed and if it was just for good measure I should have been consulted before making that decision for me.

If I  could give 10 stars, or 100 stars, I  would. Dr. Smith is a caring,  competent, professional, knowledgeable vet. She is very compassionate and understands the needs of cats and people. In 30 years of pet (cat) ownership,  we have never received such thoughtful, professional pet care. In times of need it's nice to have someone like her on your side.
They definitely treat your fur baby with lots of love and staff explained everything,  will definitely be coming back
Thank you for your wonderful feedback, Ashlyn. We appreciate your feedback!
We are utterly delighted to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.

My sister and I went in to see about our options for our elder girl cat Peanut after both of her limbs on her left side went out suddenly. Being that my sister was the primary owner, she knew that she could not afford the long term care Peanut would need. After an ultrasound and blood pressure, Dr. Moran and Jennifer walked us through the prognosis and determined it would not get better for her. They then explained the process of how she would be able to go peacefully in their office and we made the decision to go through with it. Dr. Moran and Jennifer were so empathetic towards us and allowed us as much time as we needed to say our goodbyes to Peanut throughout the process. It was a hard decision, but with their guidance, we knew we did what was best for her in the end. This experience with the staff at Feline Medical Center made a lasting impression on me and I plan to be a regular client with my own cat.

Thank you again, Dr. Moran and Jennifer, for your patience, kind words, and empathy towards us with dealing with the loss of our beloved Peanut<3
The staff are wonderful! I love being able to take my cats to a cat only veterinarian location. They are very patient with my rescue kitties!
Staff were very compassionate, friendly, and patient with our cats. Amazing vet clinic
Sweet staff and reasonable prices

Great service and reasonable prices
sweet staff

Excited about finding this wonderful medical center for cats only.  I finally feel I have found a vet who really knows my cats' needs and I am getting the answers I have been searching for.  Thank you Dr. Sims.  We are going to make a great team for my kitty's health.

The front desk team is exceptional. Frank was helpful and friendly as always today. The team is friendly and careful with my fur babies as they attend to their needs and the doctors are great. Their calm atmosphere is much appreciated by my multiple felines also! Highly recommended.
Patient, knowledgeable, informative.

The center allowed me to bring in my very sick cat without an appointment.  They took care of him , gave me a diagnosis and instructions for his care.  The next morning they called to check on him and answer any questions i might have.  I truly appreciate the excellent care and service.

We started coming to the clinic about 6 months ago due to issues with our cat, Ginnie, urinating outside of her litter box. We had seen our previous vet several times with no help. After one visit with Dr. Smith, we finally had answers and within a few days of medication, things turned around and I was no longer cleaning up accidents.
This visit was for a regular yearly health check. They talked to me about  Ginnie’s lifestyle and we made a plan for her immunizations, opting out of unnecessary shots due to her being an indoor cat.
Ginnie is a difficult patient and requires to be medicated; however, she’s not always cooperative with pre-medicating before her appointment . For this appointment they had to give a mild sedative, something our previous vet did not do which meant many appointments were not completed due to this. I always feel that we get a thorough exam and the best care  with Dr. Smith and her team and I’m always impressed.

Came here after having a bad experience at another vet with my cat. She’s super scared of the vet and I was very anxious about bringing her to a new vet. The staff here not only does everything they can to make sure your cat is comfortable but you as well. They did amazing with my pet and did an amazing job reassuring me at every step in the process. I definitely will be bringing her back here from now on.
We're overjoyed to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.

Very amazing staff! Frank is always so welcoming once entering, nurses and doctors always explaining every procedure being done to my furry baby, Thank you all for the amazing work you all do!
Wouldn’t trust anyone else but the amazing team at Feline Medical Center with my baby
Taking my cat to Feline Medical Clinic makes the visit easier on her. Knowing she's in the hands of feline medical specialist makes our visits easier on me!

The doctors at Feline Medical Center are absolutely incredible! They always take such amazing care of my precious Link, and I truly couldn’t ask for a better team. Every visit, they are kind, attentive, and take the time to explain everything so thoroughly, which gives me so much peace of mind. It’s clear how much they genuinely care about their patients, and it shows in the level of compassion and expertise they provide. Link is always in the best hands here—highly recommend to any cat parent looking for exceptional care!

This place is awesome! Staff are so enthusiastic, kind, patient, and thorough. Brought my cat here after she was misdiagnosed at another vet, and and they immediatley zeroed in on the issue and gave us comprehensive instructions on treatment and post-visit care.  We are moving soon and will be 40 minutes away, but we'll still make the drive to see this team!
They were great with Ozzie. They explained things well and gave my boy a lot of love. We will definitely be back for checkups and any other needs.

Amazing trustworthy vets and staff that are always caring and attentive to my cat's health! I have had numerous exams, various lab tests, and two surgeries (one dental and one abdominal) for my cat here. I entrust my cat's health in their very capable hands. Also, the facilities are always spotless and decorated so well for the holidays. Highly recommend!

Update: they continue to provide high quality and compassionate care for my current cats including exams and surgerical procedures. I entrust the drs and staff with my cats' lives.
Your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center is greatly appreciated. Thank you for taking the time to provide feedback.
Staff is very friendly and helpful. The Vet was great and thorough.

The best feline care
Prompt helpful and informative
So glad they are here to help!

Love this practice, Dr. Sims and Via were amazing and the reception made me feel important. Our little fur baby was in great hand and will continue to use Feline Medical Center for years to come. I highly recommend this place for your fur baby
very professional and calming for my cat.

Very impressed with the care provided by Feline Medical Center. This was both of my cats’ first visit and Dr. Smith, Sam, and Jennifer were incredibly caring and down to earth. Everyone showed genuine concern for my cats’ wellbeing and made us feel completely at ease throughout their care. Our cats were noticeably less nervous and the entire visit was smooth and stress-free. Dr. Smith and Sam answered all of my questions and took the time to explain everything during the appointment. We’ll definitely be back!

I brought my 5 year old boy in because he got into a hersheys kiss and had been throwing up for more than 30 hrs. He was in rough shape but the staff was extremely kind. Dr. Smith was quick to figure out what was wrong. She performed surgery yesterday to remove an almond that was causing an obstruction. My boy is at home purring today. I’m so grateful for the team that took care of him.
We're elated to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center. Thank you for your feedback!

I started bringing my senior cat here for boarding, and have now transitioned all 3 of my cats for vet care as well. Everyone is nice and professional. I have seen 2 vets and both were very down to earth and easy to discuss care and issues with. Very happy we made the switch to Feline Medical Center!
We're glad to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center. Thank you for your feedback.
We're ecstatic to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center. Thank you for sharing your feedback!

This is an amazing clinic with a medical staff specializing in cat medicine, wellness, and behavior. Been going here for 3 years
They keep up with the latest research on various cat health issues.

They also usually have availability and everyone here is so pleasant and engaged in what they're doing. nobody seems like they're super rushed and they really care.

They've saved my baby twice: from a tumor and the management/stabilization of his kidney issues. They also intelligently and safely were able to figure out my younger cat's chronic nasal congestion issues. So grateful for them, will never take my cats to a regular vet again.
Our cat, Hodge, was having repeated skin issues. The staff at Feline Medical was able to diagnose the issue and get it under control. Very happy with the experience.
Thank you immensely for your positive feedback!
Compassionate and professional staff with convenient location and parking. Very thankful to have a premiere feline-dedicated facility so close to home.
My new kitten was so well taken care of today by Dr. Moran, I highly recommend this cat hospital to everyone!
Quick response sending orders for food and requesting refills!
We are absolutely thrilled to receive your five-star rating and appreciate your trust in our veterinary care.
We are pleased to receive your five-star rating and sincerely value your trust in our feline care services.
We are thrilled to hear about your positive experience with our team at The Feline Medical Center.
These guys are the best!
Excellent clinic. Caring and up to date!

So happy to have this vet! I recently started brining my cat here after wanting a second opinion for something, and ended up super confident and happy with Dr Sims. The entire staff have also been so lovely and pleasant, and boost my confidence that switching vets was the right choice. Also love that this vet is cat only focused, which ensures that any concerns I have are seen through a lens of experts.

If you value your cat's life, do not use their services.  This is a corporate chain clinic only interested in driving up profits, not medical care.   Drugging a cat then telling me that the side effects are actually cancer, then wanting to do more evasive testing and when I questioned their methods, the Vet wanted to put my cat down.   Scare tactics were used.   As I took my cat home I was told she wouldn't live through the night.  I weened her off the drugs and she recovered, a year later she is happy and playful.

I spoke with the manager and was belittled for complaining and even called a "google doctor" when I pointed out the vet was using drug side effects as "proof" the cat had cancer.

I wish there was more space here to tell the whole story.  Again, if you value your pet's life this is not the place to come to.
Amazing staff, they know how to handle cats and make them comfortable.
Dr Moran and staff are excellent with diagnosis and care of Maddie

Absolutely love this Cat Only Vet. The staff is so helpful and extremely nice. My cat was in distress and I waited in the parking lot for someone to get there. Even though they were not open yet, they took my cat in and gave him the best treatment possible. You just can’t ask for a more professional and personable business with a bedside manner that is phenomenal. Thank you for all the great years of top rated service..
Always amazing service! I can’t stress enough how amazing this clinic is!
The staff is so kind a& gentle with my babies, I won't take them anywhere else 😃😃
Your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center is appreciated. Thank you for your feedback.
LOVE the Feline Medical Center! They take their time with us every time, we never feel rushed. Super friendly and caring, especially when it comes to the loss of a pet.

I recommend Feline Medical Center highly.

In my previous vets office, I often felt cats were treated like 2nd class citizens.  Several times, they can't diagnose something or refer us elsewhere.  When I finally found a vet which served us well in that office, the cat vets inevitably left after a year.  After 3 cat vets left, I had serious reservations.

Fortunately we moved.  I met Dr. Nichole M-M, by chance, in our apartment parking lot.  She said the FMC sees cars because they want to, not because they had to.

Boy, was FMC the right choice!

In our previous vet, they stated there's no dental issues for 3 years despite my frequent inquiries.  Dr. Nichole diagnosed dental issues in 3 seconds of our initial visit.  Moreover CAT scans, dental cleaning, teeth extraction are all done in FMC, no outward referral!

Chloe, whom I suspected of having sinus issues, eventually had a polyp removed from her ear.

FMC is professional.  The staff genuinely love and care about cats.

I recommend FMC highly if you have cats.  Their understanding of cats are real, not pretense.

Our family has used FMC for several years now - love Dr Sims, Dr Smith, & Dr Moran. They listen & address each concern with me. My cats get loved on each time by the amazing staff! Procedures/surgeries have always gone well! Pricing is definitely more than some vets but we trust these doctors.

The Vet & Staff are Amazing, they put together a path of healing direction for a homeless kitten I found that was in extremely poor health. I liked how my Vet listened to me then up front suggested on what needed to be done to possibly save him.

Everyone we have dealt with here has been wonderful. Special shout-outs to Catherine and Dr. Smith. They are both very sweet and personable, and they did their absolute best to make us and our cats as comfortable as possible during our visits. They truly care about the cats they see, and their bedside manners are fantastic. I would absolutely recommend them to any cat owner.

I recently took my cats here after years with another practice. Every visit has been top-notch. They’re honest and up front about pricing, and have proven to be so much more affordable than the place I’ve been at for the last 10 years. They’ve never tried to oversell me, or push unnecessary procedures. And best of all they seem to really enjoy seeing all their patients.
Wonderful, caring doctors and staff
Everything is great
Caring and wonderful staff, took their time with my spicy cat.
Love Dr. Moran and the fact that they focus solely on cats. Everyone here is so caring and kind.
What an amazing place! We are thrilled to have found such a caring facility to bring our sphynx cats.

Our cat was injured this past weekend and we took her in to get treated. The level of care and compassion shown was very comforting. Bandit was treated with love and healing medicine. Everyone was super there.
We wouldn't take our cats anywhere else!

Dr. Sims & Angela genuinely cared for my pet the entire time he was there. I felt as if they cared for him as he was their own & definitely believe they will help us both manage his high aldosterone. Will definitely be bringing my other cat once she’s due for her check up. I definitely recommend!!
They were incredibly attentive and answered every question I had. I did not feel rushed at all and had been the best vet experience I’ve ever had. Definitely recommend and we’ll be back!

Dr. Moran and staff are amazing! They’re so caring and are truly the best in their field!! Harley has some medical issues going and Dr. Moran explained everything in detail giving us a peace of mind in his future treatments!! 100% recommend for all cat moms and dads!!
Thanks for the positive feedback, Jonathan. We greatly appreciate your review.

My vet referred us here to get further testing on our cat. We had a consultation with Dr.Smith. She was kind and patient, explaining everything to us. I felt at ease taking our cat to a Feline only practice. Thank you to Dr. Smith and all the staff for being kind and thorough with the examination.

This is the best cat clinic ever! They are so sweet and caring. The staff there is amazing and a huge shout out to Dr. Moran! So professional and you can tell she cares about her clients, their cats, and especially the staff!! You're a hero <3
It's nice to have a place to take Bear with no dogs around. Staff is also helpful. Just a nice place to take Bear
Dr.Smith and all of the other staff members are amazing! They take care of all of your felines needs and they are so caring!

I'm so glad we found The Feline Medical Center! It is clean and cat friendly. The office staff is friendly, compassionate, and helpful. The vets and technicians are very knowledgeable about ALL things cats! They understand cats and know how to read their language; adjusting their processes to help ease our babies into it. While, they are a little more expensive than 'regular' vets, I feel more confident in their knowledge and ability.  As long as I live close and own cats, this will be the vet of my choice.

OK - Harry just stepped on the keyboard so this may end up being a duplicate review!  Harry is a neighborhood cat who has been visiting me for years, whenever I was in the backyard.  We would have a cuddle and I would give him some stale cat food (the bag lasted nearly a year!).  Then a few weeks ago he arrived in a very bedraggled state - thin, beaten up, bite marks going septic, hair licked off his belly and back legs.  This time he came inside and made up to me like nobody's business.  So I brought him to the Feline Medical Center on the recommendation of my sister's cat, Stella.  The staff made such a fuss of him - he loved it all (except the thermometer).  He is on a regime of medicine to help reduce the licking and is gradually growing back some hair.  The staff offered a payment plan over a year, which means when he needs another visit I don't hold back because of the cost.  The place is clean, bright, and welcoming.  The calm, black office cat watches over everything with nary a sound.  Using a sensibly spaced appointment system, the reception is rarely crowded (in my heretofore limited experience).  I love going there!  Harry does too! (well not the going bit but he likes being there...)

2025 update:  In spite of FIV, Harry lived till he was about 17, under the care of Feline Medical Center.  Harry went for his twice-a-year checkups on the PAW Plan - and numerous visits for intervening conditions.  The Feline Medical Center staff were unfailingly kind to Harry (and me).  He passed away peacefully and Dr. Moran took as much care of me in my distress as she did of Harry.

Fantastic service, open and informative communication about my cat on his wellness check up , along with diagnosis and prognosis and professional approach to future treatment. Dr. Sims  is very knowledgeable and offers detail explanations and practical advice. Loved the conversation with her on cat health and behavior. The staff are  super helpful and friendly from beginning to the of service . Thank you and Loki and I look forward to future visits.
Although my cat does not like going there, they are great with him!
Great! Dr Smith & staff were very caring and  took good care of my kitty. Thank you!!

Dr. Moran is the absolute best you can get in the state of Texas !!!! She is thorough, and treats every cat like her own. She saved my sisters cats lives, and she is absolutely amazing with my cat, Ace. I wouldn’t see anyone else.
We genuinely admire your 5-star rating! Thank you for sharing your experience.
They found the cause of my cat’s lethargy, treated and gave medicine.  He is much better one day after the visit.  Thanks
Thanks for the positive feedback, Christy! We're overjoyed to hear about your experience at The Feline Medical Center.
Thank you for being so sweet to our stray kitty. He was comfortable as best as he could be as he was getting examine. Dr. Smith was awesome, as well as our nurse. Thank you again.

I called over the phone before making an appointment with this specialist and the exam fee for my cat rocket was $108. I spoke to Frank over the phone and he was very helpful. He told me they have a sister clinic right next store that had an exam fee of $91 for anyone asking about pricing.

Dr. Smith has been so helpful with everything my cat is going through. She answers all my questions and has given me a lot of information that I didn’t have to ask for. We aren’t out of the waters yet but my cat is feeling better and gaining more weight👍🏼

From the moment we entered the clinic, I could sense the sincere care the staff has for cats and their owners. Frank and Nelson were very professional, helpful and courteous. You can just tell when someone enjoys their job! Catherine was the most friendly and informative technician I have ever met as she readied our cat for the vet visit. She offered advice for socializing our cats and spoke from many years of personal experience. And Dr. Sims was the most thorough  doctor I’ve ever had examine a pet. As she examined, she took the time to explain her findings and how to treat. What we appreciated most was her knowledge and willingness to take the time to talk to us about cat behaviors. The clinic is about an hour away from us but well worth the drive. Thank you to the staff and Dr. Sims!

The Webbs (and Nacho and Bogie)
Everyone is so nice and they are great with Peeka and Boo
We are glad to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

I LOVE Feline Medical Center! Even though they specialize in treating cats, it's no more expensive than a typical vets office! I found them bc I had a cat, Ernie, that had tooth/gum inflammation issues. My reg vet said we'd have to pull all his top teeth and it would be around $4500, so we decided to get a 2nd opinion and went to FMC! They said it was only necessary to pull his back 2 molars (which was around $1100) and that was years ago. He's now an old 17yr old kitty still going hard! I've taken my younger 2 cats here as well. The staff is always considerate, prompt/punctual, and you can get appts quickly! I will always recommend them to any cat owners!
Thank you for your generous review! We appreciate your feedback and hope to see you again soon!
Very friendly staff i highly recommend it, hardly any wait time, and they have late appointments available.
Thank you for your amazing review, Stephanie! We love what we do and are glad to be here for you and your pet!
I should have taken a picture of the nurse and doctor with Yulie. My husband, Mark Berman, also really enjoyed the visit; they were very personable to the whole family!
Great service as always for my young kitty! Thank you.
Thank you immensely for your positive feedback. We appreciate your support!

The person at the desk ws very helpful in explaining there pricing otpions. All were very nie and helpful. Very nice atmosphere plus we didn't have to worry about dogs barking. Plus there are much closer to our house than our precious vet. Also like that they specialize in felines.
I was very blessed to have Dr. Moran care for my Nugget Cat he is at the very least a little comfortable. I just found out he has a collapsed lung and a growth in his abdomen.  Thanks doc
We are pleased to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center. Thank you for sharing!
Great service from the beginning to the end. All the staff are nice and caring. I definitely recommend this place 100 percent.
Dr.Moran helped my Fancy with her paw. Very kind and informative. Fancy is feeling a little better 36 hours later. Full recovery coming soon. 💖 Great vet for your kitties 😻 …
Thank you for taking care of and having fun with Frank. Scariest moment thinking we might lose him. We can’t express how grateful we are for the whole team!!!

We purchased a kitten from a breeder and the breeder was less than honest about his health. If we hadn’t found Feline Medical Center and Dr. Sims he surely would not have made it. Dr. Sims and staff saved his life and he is now on a path to a full recovery as a result of their care and fast diagnosis and treatment plan for his various health issues. Thank you Feline Medical Center and especially Dr. Sims!!  Y’all are the best!  ❤️🙏🏻🙂
Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We are excited to hear about your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center.

The staff at the clinic are all very kind and helpful. The entire process was easy, and I felt that they really cared about my cat. He gets anxious and grumpy at the vet, and they were super patient and gentle with him. I was also very happy to learn that Dr Smith is familiar with the FIP treatment my cat has received previously. The knowledge and kindness of everyone here makes me feel like we are in good hands. Looking forward to our next visit!
Your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.
The Feline Medical Center is a wonderful veterinary practice the only takes care of cats.  They do a perfect job of taking care of my cats.
Your positive experience at The Feline Medical Center means a lot to us. Thank you for sharing your feedback, Alicia.
Great service! Very friendly and patient staff.
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your experience at The Feline Medical Center.
Brought my new kitten for his first visit. Everything was nice and cat friendly.   Office is organized  and low key. We'll be going back.
The best clinic in the area regarding result/price ratio. Professional staff and smooth service. We have had a few visits since August, and I have nothing to complain about.
The best place ever to bring your kitties!!  Amazing team and the doctors go above and beyond in their care.
My cat was treated very kindly .
The lady techs were very knowledgeable and amicable.  My kitty was happy and not totally stressed out. Cats r sensitive when not n their regular environment. All went well!

The staff are fantastic and care is exceptional! Frank is super helpful each & every time I call, and i called a lot before our visit. Catherine & Dr. Moran were super attentive and caring to our cats  needs. This is the place for your kitty!

I feel my Princess has the most thorough examination and veterinary care available at the Feline Medical Center. All of their personnel are caring and supportive. In my opinion, they offer the best care for my cat.

Took my 19-year-old cat for chronic pancreatitis. She had the most thorough exam she’s ever had in her life came home  with RX and she’s already feeling much better after only three days
well worth the drive – I live in Galveston – and well worth the money.
My kitty is beginning to be happy again. I look forward to more years with her. She’s such a sweetheart. I couldn’t stand losing her, I highly recommend this practice

The staff at the Feline Medical Center at wonderful to work with.   They explain everything as they go and are very thorough.   They don't give up until they determine the problem.  I never feel rushed.  They always have the time to do the tests they need to do and keep me informed.   They are typically running on time, which is always a nice bonus.  If I reach out with a question (either by phone or text), Nelson is quick to respond and always helpful.
